verdict.rationale: Teller is a SaaS financial-data API that handles user data, so an AI-training opt-out or a no-training policy is a fair privacy-posture question. The evidence pack covers mTLS authentication, sandbox data and API resources, but nothing about whether customer data is used to train AI models or how to opt out. Community trust concerns do not address this axis.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
